products_used_bike_serial_check.name: products_used_bike_serial_check
products_used_bike_serial_check.value: category <> 'bicicleta_usada' or serial_number is not null

purchase_orders_doc_type_check.name: purchase_orders_doc_type_check
purchase_orders_doc_type_check.value: doc_type is null or doc_type in ('factura', 'boleta', 'guia')

purchase_orders_received_check.name: purchase_orders_received_check
purchase_orders_received_check.value: status <> 'recibida' or (received_at is not null and received_by is not null)

stock_movements_sign_check.name: stock_movements_sign_check
stock_movements_sign_check.value: (kind in ('compra', 'devolucion') and quantity > 0) or (kind in ('venta', 'consumo_orden') and quantity < 0) or kind in ('ajuste', 'anulacion')

stock_movements_reference_kind_check.name: stock_movements_reference_kind_check
stock_movements_reference_kind_check.value: reference_kind is null or reference_kind in ('purchase_order', 'work_order_item', 'sale', 'sale_refund', 'import')

stock_movements_adjustment_note_check.name: stock_movements_adjustment_note_check
stock_movements_adjustment_note_check.value: kind <> 'ajuste' or note is not null

work_order_approvals_decision_check.name: work_order_approvals_decision_check
work_order_approvals_decision_check.value: (decided_at is null and decision is null) or (decided_at is not null and decision is not null and decision in ('aprobado', 'rechazado'))

work_order_items_product_check.name: work_order_items_product_check
work_order_items_product_check.value: product_id is null or (kind = 'repuesto' and unit_cost_clp is not null)

work_orders_qc_check.name: work_orders_qc_check
work_orders_qc_check.value: status not in ('lista_para_retirar', 'entregada') or qc_approved_at is not null

work_orders_tax_doc_type_check.name: work_orders_tax_doc_type_check
work_orders_tax_doc_type_check.value: tax_doc_type is null or tax_doc_type in ('boleta', 'factura')

bike_components_replaced_date_check.name: bike_components_replaced_date_check
bike_components_replaced_date_check.value: replaced_at is null or replaced_at >= installed_at

payments_net_check.name: payments_net_check
payments_net_check.value: net_clp is null or net_clp = amount_clp - fee_clp

payments_mercadopago_check.name: payments_mercadopago_check
payments_mercadopago_check.value: method <> 'mercadopago' or external_id is not null

sales_amounts_check.name: sales_amounts_check
sales_amounts_check.value: subtotal_clp >= 0 and discount_clp >= 0 and vat_clp >= 0 and total_clp >= 0 and paid_clp >= 0

sales_discount_check.name: sales_discount_check
sales_discount_check.value: discount_clp = 0 or discount_reason is not null

sales_doc_type_check.name: sales_doc_type_check
sales_doc_type_check.value: doc_type is null or doc_type in ('boleta', 'factura')

bikes_year_check.name: bikes_year_check
bikes_year_check.value: year is null or (year >= 1980 and year <= 2100)

customers_discovery_channel_check.name: customers_discovery_channel_check
customers_discovery_channel_check.value: discovery_channel is null or discovery_channel in ('instagram', 'google', 'recomendacion', 'sitio_web', 'paso_por_el_taller', 'otro')

blocked_periods_range_check.name: blocked_periods_range_check
blocked_periods_range_check.value: (start_time is null and end_time is null) or (start_time is not null and end_time is not null and start_time < end_time)

bookings_cancelled_by_check.name: bookings_cancelled_by_check
bookings_cancelled_by_check.value: cancelled_by is null or cancelled_by in ('customer', 'admin')

bookings_retiro_address_check.name: bookings_retiro_address_check
bookings_retiro_address_check.value: mode = 'taller' or (comuna in ('Vitacura', 'Las Condes') and address is not null)
